test_title: PYST 64: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Rajesh starts from Point A and drives 17 km towards West. He then takes a left turn, drives 10 km, turns left and drives 40 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 30 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 23 km and stops at Point Q. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he now drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only.)
solution:
Given:

Rajesh starts from Point A and drives 17 km towards West. 

He then takes a left turn, drives 10 km, turns left and drives 40 km. 

He then takes a left turn and drives 30 km. 

He takes a final left turn, drives 23 km and stops at Point Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4279182e40607e22f3beb5ae272b22cf89d8bc24fa7f7415b069e52a1552fa3a.png] 

So, Rajesh should go **20 km South **to reach point again.

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
